findings: Immediate listener check before CLI readiness

Retention must be asserted before workflow admission

static_source_findings.correction: TC preserves initial source bytes and corrects fixture/API use without changing accepted oracles.

static_source_findings.finding: Literal EXPECTED_PACKAGES contained35 items; typing-inspection from the original32-package lock was missing. A lock-parser count check alone did not cover the literal.
static_source_findings.correction: Return to TC source and derive the omitted accepted pin from original requirements.lock; require independent AST literal32+4 comparison before freezing.

static_source_findings.finding: TC result/process journal is nested in observations/integration, not at observations root.
static_source_findings.correction: Runner reads actual integration schema and asserts six distinct expected process roles/identities and successful clean exits.

static_source_findings.finding: Failure cleanup could rediscover descendants from an already-reaped pytest PID, and separate PID checking/signalling has a reuse race.
static_source_findings.correction: Save pytest startticks at launch, require matching root before/after descendant snapshot, use saved journal identities after exit, and open/validate pidfds before atomic pidfd_send_signal. Never signal a reused unrelated PID.

static_source_findings.finding: Old environment file hash map was only held in memory.
static_source_findings.correction: Persist private old-environment-before.json and its gate digest so before/after unchanged claims can be audited.

static_source_findings.finding: Watchdog enforcement existed but private per-case body/cleanup timestamps and timeout flags were missing.
static_source_findings.correction: Return to TC fixture to record actual five-case timing and timeout fields; JUnit remains test-outcome authority.

recovery: Preserve rejected contracts/reviews and initial source versions under attempts; complete code review and an exact-SHA pre-gate approval before the first service/test run. Runtime failures, if any, require a fresh retained gate and relevant re-review.
